create_RolloutStorage: create a RolloutStorage instance to store rollout data for RL trainers with observations, actions, and rewards buffers
insert_rollout_data: insert next observations, actions, rewards, and value predictions into the RolloutStorage buffers at the current step
compute_returns_with_GAE: compute discounted returns using Generalized Advantage Estimation or standard Monte Carlo returns across all rollout steps
generate_training_batches: generate shuffled mini-batch iterators from rollout storage data with RNN sequence build info for training
advance_rollout_step: advance the current rollout step index after inserting data to prepare for the next environment step
